# VMFleet Monitoring Workbook

This workbook visualizes VMFleet IOPS, throughput, and latency metrics from Log Analytics.

content.query:
VMFleetMetrics_CL
| where CounterName_s in ("CSVFS_ReadIOPS", "CSVFS_WriteIOPS")
| summarize AvgValue=avg(Value_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), CounterName_s
| render timechart
content.title: Read/Write IOPS

content.query:
VMFleetMetrics_CL
| where CounterName_s in ("CSVFS_ReadLatencyMs", "CSVFS_WriteLatencyMs")
| summarize P95=percentile(Value_d, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), CounterName_s
| render timechart
content.title: Read/Write Latency P95

content.query:
VMFleetMetrics_CL
| where CounterName_s in ("CSVFS_ReadMBps", "CSVFS_WriteMBps")
| summarize AvgValue=avg(Value_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), CounterName_s
| render timechart
content.title: Read/Write Throughput (MB/s)
